diagnostics.meaning: A closed system-integration record has missing, extra, or invalid data.
A binding reference does not resolve inside the selected binding set.
A reference resolves to the wrong D45-D49 record kind.
Portable input attempted to author a compiler-owned digest.
A dependency contract erased its concern behind a universal Port abstraction.
A domain Interface reference is not an explicit DS-D1.11 reference.
The selected provider-neutral profile or language profile is unknown.
Failure classification attempted to select Retry or another continuation.
A durable runtime binding omits a required concern-specific contract or binding.
Compiled binding bytes do not match their calculated digest.
Generated language source does not match the selected exact profile and binding manifest.
